mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(P.id) FROM POSTS P WHERE P.is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE POSTS SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image = #{image, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, type = #{type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, price = #{price, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, hiring_quota = #{hiringQuota, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, filled_count = #{filledCount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, is_available = #{isAvailable}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE POSTS SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT P.id, P.title, M.user_name AS author, P.type, P.created_at AS createdAt, P.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM POSTS P INNER JOIN MEMBERS M ON P.author_id = M.id WHERE P.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY P.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POSTS ( title, content, author_id, image, type, price, hiring_quota, filled_count, created_at, is_available, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, #{image, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{price, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{hiringQuota, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{filledCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{isAvailable}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT P.id, P.title, P.content, P.author_id AS authorId, P.image, P.type, P.created_at AS createdAt, P.updated_at AS updatedAt, P.is_available AS isAvailable, P.is_deleted AS isDeleted, P.price, P.hiring_quota AS hiringQuota, P.filled_count AS filledCount, M.user_name AS author FROM POSTS P INNER JOIN MEMBERS M ON P.author_id = M.id WHERE P.id = #{id} AND P.is_deleted = 0
